Name: Pet Overhaul
Author: suhbean
Description:
[b][i]COMPATIBLE WITH 1.6
[/i]
[/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/vYrsvy7.png[/img]

Pet Overhaul adds new, unique pets that can be purchased from Marnie! Instead of replacing vanilla sprites with a texture, this mod utilizes the new 1.6 feature that adds additional pet breeds. Once you have full hearts with your starter pet, you can then visit Marnie to Adopt Pets and purchase a Pet License of your choosing!

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b][/*]

[*]Unzip/extract the files into your [b]Stardew Valley > Mods folder[/b][/*]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aEVa42x.png[/img]

[i]You've got questions? I've got answers.

[/i][b][i]Where are the new pets?[/i][/b]
The new pets can be adopted from Marnie by purchasing a Pet License of your choosing! You must reach full hearts with your starter pet in order for Pet Licenses to be unlocked. This is a Vanilla feature, so if there are issues with pets not showing up in Marnie's shop, it is most likely caused by another mod that overwrites it. 

[b][i]Why can't I choose a PO pet as my starter pet?[/i][/b]
I ran into a few minor issues when play-testing, and thought it was best to keep them as adoptable pets via Pet Licenses. This may change in the future!

[b][i]Can I request a pet to be added?[/i][/b]
Absolutely! Just leave a comment with your request, and I'll definitely consider it for the next update.

[b]IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ![/b]
Soooo here's the deal with full transparency: I've rewritten the entire code for Pet Overhaul, but in the long-run it will be for the best! With that being said, if you decide to update you WILL lose your PO Pets and they will turn into a vanilla counterpart (like a cat or dog). WAIT, DO NOT PANIC! I know this is disappointing, but there's nothing I can really do about it since I'm making such major changes. I'm still brand new to modding, and constantly learning how to do things better. The new code allows for more customization (including audio, behaviors, and other features), and it will make it easier in the future to add new exciting gameplay. To be honest, I thought my mod would only get like 100 downloads MAX, so I didn't think a huge update like this would be a big deal. Good news is that this will never be a problem again!

[b]Possible Solutions:[/b]
[spoiler] [u]Obtain Butterfly Powder[/u]
[list]
[*]Purchase it from Krobus for 20,000g[/*]
[*]Spawn it in using CJB Item Spawner[/*]
[*]Spawn it in using the SMAPI Console by typing [b]debug item 142[/b][/*]
[/list][u]Use Butterfly Powder[/u]
[list]
[*]Click the Butterfly Powder on the pet you want to get rid of[/*]
[/list][u]Re-Adopt Pets
[/u]
[list]
[*]Go to Marnie's and re-adopt the pets you want[/*]
[*]Use CJB Cheats Menu to give yourself the money for the pet[/*]
[*]Or use the SMAPI Console by typing [b]player_setmoney 40000[/b] (replace 40000 with any amount you want to set you money to)[/*]
[/list]
Again, I am so so sorry you'll have to jump through these hoops if you want to update the mod - but I promise it will be for the better! And you'll never have to do this again.[/spoiler]
